mentions.name: TrailerSpoiler.com
mentions.description: A platform for rating movie trailers on how spoiler-heavy ('spoily') and how good they are, helping surface great trailers that don't spoil the movie.
mentions.problem: Bad trailers can spoil the movie — some trailers are essentially a 3-minute summary of the film.
mentions.source_excerpt:
TrailerSpoiler.com [0]

It annoys me how much a bad trailer can spoil the movie, so I made this platform to rate trailers how "spoily" they are and how good they are.
